_comment: English art briefs per character id from game.json characters[]. 'design_sk' is copied from game.json for traceability; 'description' is what goes into prompts. Ages are locked per sheet.

ADAM.design_sk: Modrá pracovná bunda, horčicové tričko, hnedá brašna, krátke tmavé vlasy; rúško v 2020 vonku pri ľuďoch. Žiadna podoba s postavami Polda.
ADAM.description: Adam, a 35-year-old Slovak man who repairs audio equipment for a living: an ordinary, likeable civilian with a dry sense of humour. Short dark brown hair, clean-shaven with a hint of stubble, friendly slightly tired face, medium build, average height. He wears an open mid-blue cotton work jacket with chest pockets and the sleeves pushed up a little, a plain mustard-yellow T-shirt underneath, dark grey-blue jeans, and sturdy brown leather shoes. A brown leather messenger bag hangs on a strap across his chest and rests on his left hip. No hat, no coat, no tie, no uniform, no badge.

variants.mask2020: Outdoors among people in 2020 he wears a light blue disposable surgical face mask over his nose and mouth.

ELA.design_sk: Zelená vesta, rúško, dva rôzne perá, pevná doska.
ELA.description: Ela, a 40-year-old Slovak woman who coordinates volunteers in 2020: brisk, matter-of-fact and kind. Shoulder-length brown hair tied back in a low ponytail, a plain bright green padded vest without any logo or text over a grey long-sleeved top, dark trousers and comfortable trainers. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth. Two different pens (one red, one black) are clipped to the vest pocket and she holds a sturdy brown clipboard against her side.
ELA.gesture: She lifts the clipboard a little in front of her with one hand and taps it with the red pen held in her other hand, as if pointing at an entry on her list.
ELA.idle_motion: She stands still in place holding her clipboard against her side, relaxed and alive: calm breathing, one natural blink, a tiny shift of weight from one foot to the other. She keeps looking ahead to the right; she does not turn her body, does not bow her head and does not look down. The clipboard stays where it is.
ELA.notes: game.json S03 art_brief says Ela sits under the side wall, but the NPC rect/clear zone is standing-sized (150x320); the sheet is standing (ISSUES ART-NPC-01).
ELA.idle_motion_checklist: She stands still in place holding her clipboard, relaxed and alive: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, a small glance down at the clipboard and back up.

DANA.design_sk: Bordová zástera, rúško, okuliare na hlave.
DANA.description: Dana, a 48-year-old Slovak shop assistant in a small village grocery in 2020: calm, precise, years behind the counter. Shoulder-length dark brown hair with a few grey strands, a pair of reading glasses pushed up on top of her head like a hairband, a kind but tired face with a few fine lines. She wears a plain burgundy (deep wine-red) bib apron without any logo or text, with one front pocket, over a cream long-sleeved blouse with the sleeves pushed to the forearms, dark grey trousers and comfortable black shoes. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). Her hands are relaxed, loosely clasped in front of the apron.
DANA.gesture: She raises one hand and touches the reading glasses on top of her head with her fingertips, as if about to pull them down to read a note; her other hand stays relaxed.
DANA.idle_motion: She stands still in place, relaxed and patient: calm breathing, a natural blink, a tiny shift of weight, her hands loosely clasped in front of her apron.

MIRA20.design_sk: Biele vlasy, okrúhle okuliare, okrový sveter; iba za zatvoreným oknom.
MIRA20.description: Mira, Adam's 80-year-old grandmother, a retired engineer at home in her house in autumn 2020: sharp-eyed, precise, quietly tender, healthy and lively (not ill, not frail). Short white hair set in soft neat waves, round thin metal-framed glasses, an alert, wry, intelligent face with fine wrinkles and a small knowing smile. She wears a warm ochre (golden yellow-brown) knitted wool sweater over a white blouse collar, dark brown trousers and comfortable house shoes. She is indoors at home, so she wears no face mask. With her right hand she holds a plain dark mobile phone (no logo) to her right ear, the phone on the far side of her head so her whole face stays visible; her left arm is relaxed.
MIRA20.gesture: Still holding the phone to her ear with one hand, she raises her free hand to chest height with the index finger lifted, making a precise point.
MIRA20.idle_motion: She stands still in place holding the phone to her ear, listening: calm breathing, a natural blink, a small attentive nod, a tiny shift of weight.
MIRA20.notes: Only ever seen behind a closed big window (S06), talking to Adam by phone. Bust export cut at the window-sill line plus a behind-glass variant.

ROMAN.design_sk: Tmavá mikina, rúško, dodávka s vymyslenou značkou ŠUP.
ROMAN.description: Roman, a 29-year-old Slovak parcel courier in 2020: relaxed, friendly, never cynical. Short dark-blond hair slightly tousled, light stubble, lean build. He wears a plain dark charcoal hooded sweatshirt (hood down) without any logo, print or text, dark navy work trousers with side pockets and grey-and-white trainers. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers his nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). He holds a small plain brown cardboard parcel (no labels, no logo) under his near arm. His van is not part of the sprite.
ROMAN.gesture: He keeps holding the one cardboard parcel exactly as before, in the same hand at the same place by his hip. He raises his other, empty hand (the arm nearest to the viewer, on the left side of the image) to shoulder height in a relaxed, friendly open-palm wave. There is only one parcel in the image.

LENKA.design_sk: Šedá bunda, rúško, vôdzka, pes s jednou čiernou škvrnou.
LENKA.description: Lenka, a 37-year-old Slovak neighbour walking her dog in 2020: economical with words, quietly amused. Chin-length dark auburn bob, a few freckles. She wears a plain mid-grey zipped soft-shell jacket without any logo, dark blue jeans and brown ankle boots. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). In her near hand she holds a tan leather leash that runs down to her dog Bodka, who stands at her feet in front of her, facing the same way: a medium-sized short-haired white mixed-breed dog with exactly one round black spot on its side, black nose, floppy ears, alert and eager, looking ahead as if it would rather run.
LENKA.gesture: She raises her free hand in a small amused open-palm shrug at shoulder height; the leash hand and the dog stay where they are.

JOZEF.description: Jozef, a 73-year-old Slovak pensioner at the village notice board in 2020: warm-hearted and a little ceremonious, upright posture. Neatly combed white-grey hair, bushy grey eyebrows. He wears a long dark brown wool overcoat, buttoned, over a light blue shirt collar, dark grey trousers and polished black shoes. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers his nose and mouth (autumn 2020, outdoors among people). In his near hand he holds a small folding pocket magnifier: a round lens that swivels out of a black case, folded.
JOZEF.gesture: He raises the unfolded pocket magnifier in front of his eye at face height, as if reading small print on a notice board.
